title: A real studio, once
body: When this park opened in May 1989 it was a working production lot. Guests on the studio tour watched animators at their desks through a glass wall, and the Florida team went from doing short segments to animating full features, including Mulan and Lilo & Stitch. The animation studio closed in 2004, and the park has been slowly shedding the backstage theme ever since.
